stem.text: A known tensile force acts on a metal wire. The wire does not exceed its limit of proportionality.
Which two measurements enable the strain of the wire to be calculated?

A.text: the unstretched length of the wire and the cross-sectional area of the wire

B.text: the unstretched length of the wire and the extension of the wire

C.text: the Young modulus of the metal and the extension of the wire

D.text: the Young modulus of the metal and the unstretched length of the wire
